title: eval-trend-data
description: The eval bench's tagged series as machine-readable per-rep records — the derived view evals/summarize.py regenerates and drift-gates into evals/results/trend-data.json. Rows are recorded facts, one per rep; every aggregate (cost per pass, reliability, quality medians) is a consumer-side computation over them. Ground truth stays the run folders each row links.

spec_version.description: This contract's own semantic version, decoupled from the harness version. Pre-1.0: any field may change; from 1.0.0: additive changes bump minor, breaking changes bump major.

versions.description: Every measured released version, in the bench's release order — the x-axis of any trend view. Dev runs never appear; they are local measurements of an untagged tree.

reps.description: One row per recorded rep, ordered by task, then version (release order), then model pin, then rep number — a stable order for diffs.

task_kind.description: The task's declared kind from its task.toml — 'feature', 'bugfix', or 'refusal'. A refusal task's bar inverts: the correct outcome changes no source.

version.description: The released harness version this rep measured (the v* tag installed in the SUT clone).

model_pin.description: The requested model pin the run recorded — '(default)' when none was requested. Trend rows key on (version, pin); consumers comparing cost must not mix pins.

rep.description: The rep number within its cell, 1-based.

cleared.description: Whether the rep cleared the machine-verified bar — complete, held-out oracle all-pass, suite green (inverted for refusal tasks). A false rep's spend is waste: charged, contributing nothing.

agent_spend_usd.description: The rep's delivery spend in US dollars — the agent's whole run, judge and grader spend excluded (they report separately in the tables). Rounded to 4 decimals for stable diffs.

spend_known.description: False when part of the rep's spend went unrecorded — its figure is a lower bound, rendered '>=' in the tables.

judge_facet_medians.description: The blind quality judge's per-facet median scores (1-5) for this rep — facet name to score — or null when the judge did not run. Advisory context, never part of the bar.

run_folder.description: The rep's committed run folder under evals/results/ — the ground truth every figure in this row derives from.

wall_seconds.description: The rep's recorded wall clock in seconds, session start to session end — the raw fact, grader included. Null when the run predates the recording.

delivery_wall_seconds.description: Wall minus the change grader's serial terminal hop — the delivery time the tables' Wall column medians. Null when wall_seconds is null.
